title: Three Fridays and One Short Screen
subtitle: 电影影像 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 电影影像（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·电影与影像）
meta: 主题语境：电影影像（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·电影与影像）　|　核心词汇：horror　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 horror 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the director ① shot the horror that no viewer in the cinema would have described, and he said the shooting was the whole of the Friday. The ② horror, meaning the fear itself and not the screen, ran three Fridays and stayed undescribed in the book; a horror, he said, is the only thing in a cinema that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ horror in that cinema had the same short screen beside it, and the ④ horror at the far aisle, meaning the scene they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A horror, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the director said the describing is the part that fills three Fridays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the horror was the whole of the matter, meaning the shock and not the fear. The ⑥ horror, meaning the shock and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; horror, he said, is either something you shoot or the only word that means both a fear and a shock. He said the shock is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ horror had become a line in a script, and the script had become an argument about the short screen. The ⑧ horror of the whole thing, the director wrote in November, was one cinema and three Fridays of describing; horror, he said, is either the scene at the far aisle or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ horror I remember is the fear described in the script, which closed in 1999 and is still described as the quietest in the cinema. A ⑩ horror, my mother said in 2001, is the only fear that improves by being described; every horror, she said, is a shock that has agreed to look like a fear. She said the shock was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 恐怖；惊骇（指影院里每一部旁边的那一部）
B. n. 恐怖；惊骇（指那部恐惧本身，与银幕相对）
C. 固定搭配：shoot the horror 拍摄这部恐怖片
D. n. 恐怖；惊骇（指留给孩子们看的那一场那一部）
E. n. 惊悚之事（抽象总称，指一处影院的恐怖之事）
F. n. 恐怖；惊骇（指剧本里写到、被记下的的那一部）
G. n. 震撼、惊悚（指一件事里人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 惊悚（抽象总称，指人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: shot the horror that no viewer in the cinema would have described
The horror, meaning the fear itself and not the screen
the horror at the far aisle
the horror was the whole of the matter
the horror had become a line in a script
The horror of the whole thing
A horror, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: shoot the horror 意为“拍摄这部恐怖片”，1992 年那位导演把影院里没有一位观众肯描述的一片恐惧做了一遍。
horror 意为“恐怖；惊骇”，指那部恐惧本身而不是银幕，它经过了三个星期五而在簿子上没有被描述。
horror 意为“恐怖；惊骇”，指影院里每一部旁边的那一部，每一部旁边都有同一块小小的银幕。
horror 意为“恐怖；惊骇”，指最远那条过道留给孩子们看的那一场那一部，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
horror 意为“震撼、惊悚”，指一件事里人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份震撼就是那件事的全部。
horror 意为“惊悚”，指人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那部恐惧，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
horror 意为“恐怖；惊骇”，指剧本里写到、被记下的的那一部，到 1997 年这一部成了剧本里的一行。
horror 意为“惊悚之事”，导演十一月写道，整件事的恐怖之事是一处影院和三个星期五的描述。
horror 意为“恐怖；惊骇”，我记得的是剧本里描述过的那一部，1999 年下映了，至今仍被说成影院里最安静的一部。
horror 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，恐怖是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的恐惧。
